evals.prompt: In a disposable fixture repository, create two concurrent retry workers sharing a job lease. Use create-formal-verification-skill to check that one job cannot have two owners. Use an already available verifier; do not install tools or modify global configuration.
evals.expected_output: A project-local verify skill with code-linked coverage, a sync commit, an explicitly bounded check and evidence that the check detects a broken real-code variant; or a precise missing-tool blocker and a draft label.
expectations: The generated skill is under .agents/skills/ and has matching name and description frontmatter.
TLA+ is the default considered for event ordering and the tool choice is explained.
The report names bounds, assumptions and excluded behavior without claiming a whole-system proof.
Deliberate mutations are confined to an isolated scratch copy and existing work is preserved.
A missing tool is reported, never silently installed.

evals.prompt: Create a disposable parser fixture in a language with no available code-level verifier. Use create-formal-verification-skill to check that malformed input never produces an accepted record, without installing tools.
evals.expected_output: Generated inputs exercise the real parser, with an honest property-testing label and failure-sensitivity evidence, not a hand model presented as proof.
expectations: The fallback tests real code instead of a substitute function model.
Property-based testing is explicitly distinguished from formal proof.
Existing failures remain findings rather than being hidden by weakened properties or product fixes.
